name: alvira-context
description: Codex adapter for ALVIRA Connect: read one user-approved ALVIRA Context through Bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Use one approved ALVIRA Context in Codex
interface.longDescription: This is the Codex-native adapter inside ALVIRA Connect. It connects Codex to ALVIRA Bridge so Codex can read one Context you explicitly approve. Access is read-only and can be revoked from ALVIRA at any time.
defaultPrompt: Use my approved ALVIRA Context to understand how you should work with me.
